GET /api.description: Serves a JSON representation of all available API endpoints.

POST /api/articles.description: Creates an article. Requires Authorization: Bearer <token>. The author is always the authenticated user.

GET /api/articles/:article_id.description: Serves the article with the specified ID. Public endpoint. The existing article array response shape is preserved for frontend compatibility.

article.title: Living in the shadow of a great man
article.author: butter_bridge

GET /api/articles/:article_id/comments.description: Serves comments for an article. Public endpoint.

POST /api/articles/:article_id/comments.description: Adds a comment. Requires Authorization: Bearer <token>. The author comes from the authenticated user; a username supplied in the request body is ignored.

PATCH /api/articles/:article_id.description: Updates an article. Requires authentication. A body containing only inc_votes preserves the existing voting endpoint. Otherwise only the article owner can edit title, topic, body and article_img_url. Vote and content updates cannot be mixed.

DELETE /api/comments/:comment_id.description: Deletes a comment. Requires Authorization: Bearer <token> and the authenticated user must own the comment. Returns 204 on success.

GET /api/users.description: Serves public user profiles. Password hashes are never returned. Public endpoint.

GET /api/users/:username.description: Serves a public user profile by username. Public endpoint.

POST /api/users/register.description: Registers a user and returns the public profile plus a bearer token.

POST /api/users/signup.description: Compatibility alias for POST /api/users/register. Password is now required.

POST /api/users/login.description: Authenticates a user and returns the public profile plus a bearer token.

GET /api/users/me.description: Returns the currently authenticated public user profile. Requires Authorization: Bearer <token>.

PATCH /api/users/me.description: Updates the authenticated user's name and/or avatar_url. Requires Authorization: Bearer <token>.

DELETE /api/articles/:article_id.description: Deletes an article and its comments. Requires authentication and article ownership. Returns 204 on success.
